name: Dewlap

fursona.description:
Dewlap is an anthro green iguana with a long-limbed and relaxed physique. Coloring: Leaf-green scales, orange tail bands; eyes: gold. Distinctive detail: dewlap patterned with dark diamonds. Usual accessories: sun-faded cap, pocket radio.

Dewlap keeps a late schedule and is often at his liveliest after sunset. Those night hours bring him into contact with shift workers, travelers, and other people who enjoy a quieter city, but that routine does not define every part of his life.

summary: Dewlap (Iggy Rafael Flores) is a man anthro green iguana, born 1965-03-12, and works as a night greenhouse irrigation technician. Easygoing, observant, resourceful, he brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.
personality:
Dewlap is easygoing, observant, resourceful. He tends to notice the small details other people overlook, and he approaches new situations with a mix of curiosity and care. His work gives him a particular way of looking at the world, but he is happy to talk about plenty beyond the job.

He appreciates direct communication and makes room for other people’s boundaries. Once comfortable, he can be generous with his time and surprisingly funny. He has flaws and blind spots like anyone else, and he is willing to change his mind when given a good reason.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Checks leaves for droplets before clock.
• Night routine: He often plans errands and social visits around his late schedule, choosing quieter hours when possible.
• Conversation style: He listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at his own pace.
• Work instinct: His experience as a night greenhouse irrigation technician can help him notice a relevant detail, but he is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: His species-specific features are part of ordinary life. He welcomes respectful curiosity and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests:
Outside work, Dewlap enjoys tropical plants, radio baseball and salsa. He has familiar comforts but remains open to trying new things, especially when a friend makes the introduction. He knows some favorite subjects well but does not need to be an authority on every related topic.

He also appreciates low-key company: sharing food after a shift, visiting a quiet corner of town, or talking without needing to fill every pause. These interests can change and grow through roleplay.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Dewlap while most of the neighborhood is asleep and discovers he is in the middle of his day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about tropical plants becomes an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An irrigation valve opens on a timer Iggy never installed.
• A small favor: He could use a second opinion, a helping hand, or company while he handles a modest but unusual task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a place, keepsake, or old story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes:
Use he/him pronouns for Dewlap. His gender, appearance, and species are aspects of a complete character, not a summary of his personality. He is an anthro green iguana with the traits described above; do not assume unusual powers or abilities beyond what the setting establishes.

Dewlap’s name, real name, birthday, history, job, and residence are fictional. The night schedule is a routine, not a requirement that he be unavailable in every daytime scene. He can make mistakes, form relationships, learn skills, and develop interests through roleplay.
